gpt-image-2.summary: Hits almost every requirement: real blue hour, dense fog at the base, and genuinely varied interior lighting. Only the wet pavement is underdone.

massing: All volumes hold silhouette, proportion and position through the lighting change.
camera: Framing and horizon match the source.
blue_hour_sky: Deep blue-violet with low ambient — reads as dusk rather than night.
warm_glow: pass
Facades and signage glow warm against the cool sky, giving real colour-temperature contrast.
fog: pass
Dense fog through the street and lower levels, obscuring the tower base and visibly diffusing the background towers.
inhabited_interiors: pass
Window lighting varies floor to floor with lit and dark bays and warm interior depth — not a uniform glow.
wet_reflections: partial
The street picks up some sheen and vehicle light, but there is no clear reflection of the glowing facades.
signage_integrity: SIGNAGE legible and the green LED screen intact.

gpt-image-1.5.summary: The most cinematic image of the thirteen, on a building it substantially rebuilt. Every atmospheric requirement met; massing and camera both lost.

massing: The tower is reproportioned much shorter and blockier, the terraces are relocated, and the right-hand louvred box is replaced by a different dark volume.
camera: Dollied in with a lowered horizon; the building fills far more of the frame than the source.
blue_hour_sky: Deep blue-violet with dramatic cloud structure and low ambient.
warm_glow: pass
Powerful warm facade and signage glow against the cool dusk.
fog: pass
Heavy fog rolling through the street, obscuring the base and diffusing the light sources.
inhabited_interiors: pass
Strongly varied window lighting with warm interior depth across floors.
wet_reflections: pass
Clear wet pavement carrying reflections of the facades and street lights.
cinematic: Extremely dramatic — the strongest mood in the task.
signage_integrity: The lower SIGNAGE block reads cleanly, but a second sign at mid-level is garbled into overlapping glyphs.

Nano Banana 2.summary: Outstanding interior occupancy — figures visible at the glass — but the street stays dry and the fog never becomes dense.

massing: All volumes hold position and proportion.
blue_hour_sky: Deep blue-violet dusk with low ambient light.
warm_glow: pass
Warm interior and podium light reads clearly against the cool sky.
fog: partial
Atmospheric haze softens the background, but the tower base stays clearly legible — not the dense fog through the street the instruction asks for.
inhabited_interiors: pass
Excellent — floor-by-floor variation with figures and furniture silhouettes visible at the glass.
wet_reflections: fail
The ground plane is dry, with no reflection of the glowing facades.
cinematic: Moody but restrained; contrast is not pushed to the dramatic level asked for.
signage_integrity: The SIGNAGE lettering is lost to a glowing blur and the green LED screen is replaced by an indistinct warm panel.

Nano Banana 2 Lite.summary: Holds the building and lights the interiors convincingly at the lowest cost in the field; loses the wet street and the density of the fog.

massing: Volumes, proportions and positions all preserved.
warm_glow: pass

fog: partial
Haze softens the background and mid-ground, but the tower base remains clearly visible.
inhabited_interiors: pass
Strong floor-by-floor variation with visible figures and furniture.
wet_reflections: fail
Dry ground plane with no facade reflection.
signage_integrity: SIGNAGE legible and the green screen preserved.

Nano Banana Pro.summary: The best inhabited interiors in the benchmark — coloured, populated, floor by floor. Undone by a dry street and thin fog.

camera: Framing and horizon match the source.
warm_glow: pass

fog: partial

FLUX.2 Max.summary: Superb wet street and interior depth, pushed past blue hour into night, on a podium that has grown extra volumes to the right.

camera: Viewpoint and horizon broadly match the source.
blue_hour_sky: Blue-violet in hue but darkened close to full night; the residual sky light that defines blue hour is largely gone.
warm_glow: pass

fog: partial

inhabited_interiors: pass

wet_reflections: pass
Strongly wet foreground carrying clear reflections of the lit facades.
cinematic: The most atmospheric image in the task — heavy contrast and real depth.
signage_integrity: SIGNAGE legible on the podium wall.
